content: Mawari wewiwamete kememɨte'upatsie
»Pemɨwapatakɨ nemawari wewiwamete memakɨnekɨ nehetsiemieme, mɨpaɨ pekatiniyurimɨkɨ: Xeime tsikeru pekanimiemɨkɨ xeiwiyari hɨkame meta yuhutame muxatsi 'ukitsi 'aixɨa me'anenekame,
tɨriku mɨtɨxiyarikɨ paa pepɨtiwewieni meta tsuira tikuxanariyame kanɨkame pɨwiyamatɨkani xeikɨa, yaxeikɨata kɨxau tikuxanariyame kanɨkame pepɨtiwewieni wiyamatɨkaime.
Tsikɨiwititsie paa kenekamana, tsuira meta kɨxau metatsiere meyuhutame muxatsi 'ukitsi keneneuxatɨa.
Hikɨ pepɨwaranuwitɨni 'Aruni meta niwemama 'ixuriki tukiyari manuwe hɨxie, mana pepɨwa'ɨya.
'Aruni kemarite ketinanakatɨtɨa kamixa 'amɨtewi meta heriemieme kamixa 'etsimɨnena hɨxiena mieme yunɨkame kukayari meta kamixa tixukame. Kuka tawitsie mieme pɨtapierixɨani hɨiyametsie
mukuretsi mu'uyatsie kenanukuwiri meta tseyu hamakama mɨpatsie.
Hatseiti mɨtiyupata keneukawiri mu'uyatsie.
Hikɨta niwemama keniwarawitɨka kamixa 'amɨtɨtɨ keniwaranakatɨtɨa,
meta mukuretsi hetsiemieme, hikɨta 'Aruni meta niwemama wahɨiyamekɨ pepɨwaranahɨaxɨani. Mɨpaɨ pepɨtiwahɨritɨani, meta mawari wewiwamete mɨkɨ nuiwari wahetsiemieme 'aitsika pɨhɨkɨtɨni yuheyemekɨ.
»Tsikeru kene'atɨa tuki hɨxie mana 'Aruni meta niwemama mu'uyatsie yumamakɨ memeutimenikɨ,
mana Yawé hɨxie pepitimawa tsikeru.
'A'itɨwamekɨ xuriyatsie keneme'i mawari taiyame 'awayatsie keneuxurima, muyuhayewata xuriya mawari taiyame hetɨa pepitiyeurieni.
Nema meta muume muhuta wiyayari mi'eimatɨka keneukaxiteki naime, keneutitaiya mawari taiyametsie,
peru tsikeru waiyari, nawiyari meta kwitaya pepititaiya 'ateewa xemakuteitsie, mɨkɨ mawari memɨ'itiyanikɨ pɨhɨkɨtɨni.
»Xeime muxa 'uki pepɨwahana 'Aruni meta niwemama mu'uyatsie memeutimenikɨ,
hikɨ pepitimawa, xuriyayakɨ mawari taiyame pepɨta'ɨya meta nauka 'etsatanayaritsie.
Muxa keneutixitexɨa, kwinuri petihauxime meta 'ɨkateya, 'etsimɨpepetsie perapime meta muxa mu'uya,
muxa naime pekanitataiyamɨkɨ mawari taiyametsie. Mɨkɨ mawari taiyariyari, 'imikieri taipa warɨkariekame kanihɨkɨtɨni, witsimu'ɨa Yawé minake.
»Xeime muxa tawari kene'atɨa, 'Aruni meta niwemama mu'uyatsie memeutimenikɨ,

hikɨ muxa pekanimiemɨkɨ, 'Aruni nakaya heima 'etsiwa tserietana mieme pekanixurimamɨkɨ yaxeikɨata niwemama, meta wa'itɨwame 'amupapa watserieta miemetsie meta wa'ɨkatsie 'amupapayari watserieta miemetsie. 'Ariketa mawari taiyame xuriyakɨ pekanita'ɨyamɨkɨ meta nauka 'etsatanayaritsie,

meta 'etsiwa xuriyakɨ metatsiere 'etsiwa hatseiti mɨtiyupatakɨ, 'Aruni niwemama yunaime keniwaruti'ɨya wakemaritetsie. Mɨpaɨ 'Aruni meta niwemama mepatsietɨ mepakɨne meta wakemarite tipatsietɨ pɨrayani.
»'Ikɨ muxa mawari wewiwamete mɨwapatakɨ mɨ'ayumiemekɨ, kwaxieya keneuti'uta, kwinurite wiyayari, nema, muume muhuta, meta teuri tserietana mieme.
Paa tsikɨiwititsie mɨyemane tikuxanariyame mɨkanɨitɨarie Yawé hɨxie mama, xeime paa pekananati'ɨimɨkɨ meta tsuira mɨwiyama xeimeta mɨkɨxauni,
naime 'Aruni meta niwemama ketiniwayetuiri teikɨ memeitserakɨ mawari Yawé hetsiemieme mɨhɨkɨkɨ.
Mɨkɨ kwitɨwa mepɨmatsiyetuirieni 'ekɨ Yawé hɨxie pemititaiyakɨ mawari taiyametsie mawari taiyariyari witsimu'ɨa yɨnɨkame, 'ikɨ 'imikieri taipa warɨkariekame kanihɨkɨtɨni Yawé hetsiemieme.

'Ariketa muxa tawieyatsie mieme wai pekananatituimɨkɨ, mɨ'inɨariyarikɨ 'Aruni kemɨranayexeiyarie nemawari wewiwame mayanikɨ, hikɨ mawari Yawé hɨxie pekaniyuitɨwamɨkɨ, 'ikɨ kani'ayumiemetɨni mawari muyuitɨariwa mɨhɨkɨkɨ. Mɨkɨ muyuhayewa 'ahetsiemieme payani.
»Keneuti'uta tsikeru waiyarieya tawitsie mieme mawari muyuitɨariwa mayeitɨarie 'Aruni meta niwemama heitserie memɨpitɨarienikɨ, yaxeikɨata teuri mawari mayeitɨarie, mɨkɨ pɨwahetsiemieme.
'Ipaɨ tipaɨmetɨ xehetsiemieme pɨrayeikani kepauka 'ixaheritsixi 'aixɨa memɨteyuxeiya mawariyari memɨwewie Yawé hetsiemieme, mɨkɨ mepɨteyetuiriyarɨwani 'Aruni meta niwemama.
»'Aruni kemarieya mɨpatsie 'uxa'atɨniwarie nuiwarimama wahetsiemieme payani, heitserie memexeiyanikɨ mepatsietɨ mete'aitatɨ mawari wewiwamete memɨhɨkɨtɨnikɨ.
Tsepa ke'anetɨ mawari wewiwame 'Aruni nuiwarieyatɨtɨ netukita munuani muyepatsietsie mɨtita'uximayatakɨ, mɨkɨ kamixate pɨranakatɨkɨni 'atahuta tukari.
»Mɨkɨ muxa kɨmana memupatsie, keneuka'etsa xaɨtsie muyepatsietsie.
'Ixuriki tukiyari manuwe mɨranutahakitɨretsie, 'Aruni meta niwemama muxa waiyarieya mepɨtikwani meta paa tsikɨiwititsie mɨyemane.
Mɨkɨ 'imikierikɨ mepɨ'itiyaka, mɨkɨkɨ heitserie memexeiyanikɨ mete'aitatɨ meta mepɨpatsie, mɨkɨ xeikɨa mepɨyɨwaweni memitikwani, xewitɨ tawarita pɨkayɨwe, mawari mɨpatsie mɨhɨkɨkɨ.
Xɨka 'uyuhayewa muxa waiyarieya meta paa, 'uxa'arieka keneutitaiya. Pɨkayɨweni mɨtikwaiyanikɨ, mɨkɨ mawari mɨpatsie mɨhɨkɨkɨ.
»Yaketineuyuri kenematiu'aitɨa 'Aruni hetsiemieme meta niwemama wahetsiemieme. 'Atahuta tukari pepuyurieni mɨkɨ hɨritɨarika pemɨwapitɨanikɨ.
Xexuime tukaritsie tsikeru xeime peputimawani kɨmana xemɨ'itiyakakɨ. Pɨ'itiyaka mawari taiyame mawari hetsiena mieme pepɨwewieni, hatseiti mɨtiyupatakɨ pepi'ɨya.
Mɨpaɨ pepɨtiyurieneni 'atahuta tukari. Mɨpaɨ mawari wewiwame meta tita mɨtiyuitɨani 'itiyatɨ payani.
»Xexuime tukaritsie pepɨwarutimawani yuhutame muxatsi xeiwiyari memɨhɨtɨka mawari taiyametsie.
Ximeri kahekɨareyu xeime pekanitimawamɨkɨ, xeimeta taikai.
Ximeri pemitimawa matɨa, huta kiruyari tɨriku mɨtɨxiyari pepɨtimawa meta huriwa hatseitiyari nɨkame, meta winu xeirituruyari.
Xeime taikai pemɨtimawa muxa, mɨkɨ mawari taiyariyari payani, witsimu'ɨa Yawé minake meta tinɨkame ximeri timieme hepaɨ.
»Xenuiwarima memɨtinunuiwa yaxeikɨa Yawé hetsiemieme mawari taiyariyari mepuwewieka. Netuki 'ixurikiyari manuwe hɨxie xepɨteyurieka, ne 'ahamatɨa mana nemɨrataxatatsie,
yaxeikɨa 'ixaheritsixi wahamatɨa nemanetixexeɨriwatsie. Netɨrɨkariya witsimɨ'ane mana katinakupatamɨkɨ.
»Patsiekame nekanayeitɨamɨkɨ mɨkɨ tuki 'ixurikiyari meta mawari wewiwame, meta 'Aruni meta niwemama mepatsiekame nekaniwarayeitɨamɨkɨ memɨte'uximayakakɨ nehetsiemieme mawari wewiwametekɨ.
'Ixaheritsixi wahamatɨa nekaniuyeikamɨkɨ, wakakaɨyari nepɨhɨkɨtɨni.
'Ana mɨpaɨ mepɨtehetimani kename ne Yawé nehɨkɨ wakakaɨyari. 'Ekipitu nemɨwarayewitɨ wahamatɨa nemuyeikanikɨ. Ne Yawé xekakaɨyari nekanihɨkɨtɨni.
